name: Intake (TAP Speak)
purpose: Capture your plain-language ask and translate to sector + run type.
math_model: Intent classification → sector/run via rule mapping

name: Pre-Go 4Q Profile
purpose: Lock the 4 key fields before computation.

name: Input Assembly
inputs: IHS_Master_Reference_Set.*; user files; optional web refs
science_checks: Check peer-reviewed vs web; prefer primary sources
technical_process: Create Source Ledger; compute SHA-256 hashes

name: Model Selection
purpose: Pick the math model appropriate to sector.
math_model: 3–5 variable weighted score S = Σ w_i x_i; normalize to [0,1]
science_checks: For biotech: method outline per paper; For business: finance sanity bounds
technical_process: Record model config in run JSON

name: Computation & Simulation
purpose: Run the model to produce raw scores.
math_model: Examples: Expectancy E = p_win*avg_win − p_loss*avg_loss; Survival P=σ(β0+Σβ_i x_i)
science_checks: Cross-check units, ranges, sample size notes

name: Scientific/Financial Validation
inputs: Biotech papers; Psychology of Money; Accounting CSV

name: Credibility Gatekeeper (SCMS)
purpose: Score the 6 layers and compute DCI.
inputs: Security, Math, Science, Finance, Philosophy, Business layers
science_checks: Layer thresholds: Math/Phil ≥80; Sci/Fin/Bus ≥70; Security=hash match

name: Deliverable Assembly
purpose: Format per profession (paper, kit, report, proposal, formula).
math_model: UPAMS mapping: band via quantiles; margin of error via bootstrap/CI if available
science_checks: Method section includes references & novelty tag

name: Professional Readout
science_checks: Quality statement uses DCI band; usage steps = 5-step procedural
